name: Sunday morning (short)
description: Twelve-step walk from the pre-service countdown through welcome, hymn, scripture, sermon and benediction. Synthetic transcript; speaker roles match the default mixer channel map.

entries.transcript: Good morning and welcome to worship. Please stand as we begin with our opening hymn.
Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, early in the morning our song shall rise to thee.
Holy, holy, holy, merciful and mighty, God in three persons, blessed Trinity.
Our scripture reading this morning is from the Gospel of John, chapter one, verses one through fourteen.
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. This is the Word of the Lord.
Thank you. Please be seated. This morning I want to talk about what it means for the Word to become flesh and dwell among us.
John doesn't start with a stable or a star. He starts before creation, and then he brings it all the way down to a neighbourhood.
So let us pray. Gracious God, make your Word flesh in us this week. Amen.
Now may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Go in peace to love and serve the Lord.
Thanks be to God. Amen and amen.
